Fortude · September 2022 – November 2024
Selected interfaces from my professional portfolio, with context for the work I supported.

What is FastReactPlan?

FastReactPlan is Coats Digital’s production planning and control software for garment manufacturers. It helps teams schedule work across factory lines, assess capacity, coordinate material requirements and track pre-production tasks. It connects with wider business systems so planners can work with relevant operational data.

At Fortude, I provided functional support in this planning environment: helping users, investigating incidents, preparing reports, handling data and coordinating across connected teams and systems.
